title: Diversity Curves for Graph Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.06466v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph-level representations are crucial tools for characterising structural differences between graphs. However, comparing graphs with different cardinalities, even when sampled from the same underlying distribution, remains challenging. Unsupervised tasks in particular require interpretable, scalable, and reliable size-aware graph representations. Our work addresses these issues by tracking the structural diversity of a graph across coarsening levels. The resulting graph embeddings, which we denote diversity curves, are interpretable by construction, efficient, and directly comparable across coarsening hierarchies. Specifically, we track the spread of graphs, a novel isometry invariant that is inherently well-suited for encoding the metric diversity and geometry of graphs. translated_title: 用于图表示学习的多样性曲线
translated_abstract: 图级表征是刻画图之间结构差异的重要工具。然而，即使是从同一底层分布中采样的图，比较具有不同基数的图仍然充满挑战。尤其是无监督任务，需要可解释、可扩展且可靠的尺寸感知图表示。我们的工作通过在粗化层级上跟踪图的结构多样性来解决这些问题。由此得到的图嵌入——我们称之为多样性曲线——在构建上具有可解释性、高效性，并且可以在粗化层次结构之间直接比较。具体而言，我们跟踪图的散度，这是一种新颖的等距不变量，天然适合编码图的度量多样性与几何特性。我们利用边收缩粗化方法，并证明了这种方法能提升表达能力，从而产生比结构描述符更强大的图级表示。
tldr: 该论文提出通过在图粗化层级上跟踪结构多样性，利用新颖的等距不变量“图散度”构建可解释、高效且可跨不同尺寸图直接比较的图嵌入“多样性曲线”，并通过边收缩粗化提升了图级表示的表达能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "diversity curves" — interpretable, efficient graph embeddings obtained by tracking a graph's structural diversity across coarsening levels via a novel isometry invariant called the spread, with edge contraction coarsening provably enhancing expressivity for size-aware graph-level representations.
